generation: All 81 cells use fresh independent acquisitions, including the 8000-signal, r=0.20 anchor conditions. A replicate block contains two independent strategies, each paying its entire transmitted-signal budget. Full counts are Multinomial(T;1/8,1/8,1/8,1/8,1/2), then conditional binomial errors; scaling uses independent binomial sifting/error counts at each setting. Ideal interception, no readout noise or drift.
estimation: Unchanged physical binomial likelihood, bounds pA,pB in [0,0.24975], r in [0,1], independently unknown devices. likelihood.py is byte-identical to the frozen observation_validation implementation. Full transition and four-setting aggregate fits retain residual profiles; B+ operating counts are stored but no unidentified point estimate is assigned.
design: The cap-4 design and allocations are transferred without retuning for budget, interception, circuit, or outcomes. No design search or estimator selection uses these acquisitions.
statistics: Primary contrast is MAE(full)-MAE(scaling), in percentage points. Positive values favor scaling. Independent-acquisition standard errors use the sum of replicate absolute-error variances divided by 500; Welch t critical values give pointwise 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals cover the 54 identified full/scaling cells. Cell means, bias, profile coverage with Wilson Monte Carlo intervals, width quantiles, and boundary fractions are retained. No B+ full-data MAE contrast is computed.
scope: A focused within-model operating-grid study, not hardware validation, unknown-readout robustness, acquisition optimality, or a new reconciliation experiment. Conditions and methods are fixed before generation.
